scope: Local update/delete index-maintenance comparison; not the official benchmark.

workload.update: UPDATE 100 rows by id range, then one filtered TopK
workload.delete: DELETE 100 rows by id range, then one filtered TopK

correctness: container lifecycle: SIGKILL/EOF/SIGTERM checks passed, no OOM
limitations: Fixed single run per image for the update/delete cycles; the delete difference is within noise.
The update path is not part of the insert-only official performance workload, so this is not an E claim.
Rollback invalidates the table and rebuilds the snapshot; commit keeps the patch.

scale_100k.note: 10 cycles of updating 100 vectors plus one filtered TopK; the 51 MB snapshot uses the mapped-file path. The patch scans 100,000 keys per statement (~1 ms) instead of rebuilding the snapshot.
